sloka: आसन्कृतयुगे राम ब्रह्मभूते पुरायुगे ।अपार्थिवाः प्रजाः सर्वाः सुराणां तु शतक्रतुः ।। ७.७६.३७ ॥
transliteration: āsankṛtayuge rāma brahmabhūte purāyuge ।apārthivāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ surāṇāṁ tu śatakratuḥ ।। 7.76.37 ॥

translations.english: The great sage began by telling Rama that in the ancient Krita Yuga, when the world was pure, all people were without an earthly king, though Indra was the ruler of the gods.
